claim_boundary: Passing this contract establishes eight fixed-point Gaussian control cases and one structural-only Poisson-preparation control across the loading-mask and known-covariance R feature. It does not establish a GLLVM.jl `lambda_constraint` or `known_V` public surface, a native fit, a formula surface, an RCall.jl bridge, or coverage of the eight rejected fixture cases beyond the two used here as negative controls.
loading_layout: Raw rank-two loading vector has five coordinates L11,L22,L21,L31,L32 packed as: L[1,1]=theta[1], L[2,2]=theta[2], L[2,1]=theta[3], L[3,1]=theta[4], L[3,2]=theta[5].

cases.julia_surface: Julia must add V+1e-8I to sigma_eps^2*I over the 54 stacked observations and reproduce the frozen R normalized nll and gradient at points P1/P2.

meta_known_V must prepare an input byte-identical to KNOWN-EXACT (same prepared R input; there is no independent Julia code path to test beyond that identity), and must reproduce the same frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2.

Julia must add the block-structured VB+1e-8I (noncontiguous study row groups, heterogeneous per-study diagonal variance, within-study rho=.25) to sigma_eps^2*I and reproduce the frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2.

Julia must admit a zero known_V (regularized to V0+1e-8I, not rejected as degenerate) and reproduce the frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2. Exempt from the drop-known-V negative control since V0 is already zero.

Julia must reconstruct Lambda from 3 free `theta_rr_B` coordinates plus 2 pinned coordinates (L11=.8, L32=0) packed diagonal-first then strict-lower, form sigma_eps^2*I + I_18[site,site]*(Lambda Lambda')[trait,trait], and reproduce the frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2.

Julia must ignore the above-diagonal mask entry (L12=99) entirely: the prepared input must be byte-identical to MASK-B-PINS, and the same reconstruction and frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2 must reproduce MASK-B-PINS exactly.
Julia must leave zero free `theta_rr_B` coordinates (all five raw coordinates pinned to c(.8,.7,.1,.2,-.15)) while retaining z_B as a random effect, and reproduce the frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2.

Julia must reconstruct Lambda from 3 free `theta_rr_phy` coordinates plus 2 pinned coordinates (L11=.8, L32=0), form sigma_eps^2*I + C[species,species]*(Lambda Lambda')[trait,trait] over the animal source C=.7I+.3J+1e-8I, and reproduce the frozen nll/gradient at P1/P2.

Structural preparation equality only: R itself makes no density/fit claim for this case (it is the ninth prepared model, Poisson response with known Gaussian log-predictor effects). No fixed-point nll/gradient comparand exists.

negative_controls_batch.note: Two fixture rows outside the 9 required cases double as batch-level absent/corrupt-input rejection controls; both are REJECTED_BEFORE_TAPE in the frozen fixture.

cases.expected_error_contains: known_V must be n_obs x n_obs

required_health_checks: each required-case R call reaches the frozen fixture's expected admission outcome (PREPARED for all 9)
KNOWN-ALIAS input byte-identical to KNOWN-EXACT input; MASK-B-UPPER input byte-identical to MASK-B-PINS input
KNOWN-BLOCK's VB independently reconstructed from per-study rho=.25 block structure matches the fixture's VB to <1e-14
both batch negative-control fixture rows are rejected with their expected diagnostic substring
every Gaussian point (16 of them) passes abs_nll_delta, central_fd_scaled_gradient_error and its negative-control floors
KNOWN-POISSON reaches PREPARED with no nll/gradient claim attached
failure_action: Retain the complete attempt. A case whose spec is unimplementable as written gets status SPEC-DEFECT with the reason recorded, never a silent skip. Do not widen tolerances.
